name: calendar_snapshot

ownership.argument: Borrowed live image child, raw color format16 for ARGB8888. Serialized UI owner, no concurrent/reentrant snapshots.
ownership.return_value: Owned draw buffer or NULL. Non-NULL does NOT prove GPU completion.

side_effects: Power-management acquire/release and temporary global/display draw state. Must finish GPU and synchronize pixel caches before CPU read/release; one bounded pending generation after fence failure.
